title: Anagram Check
prompt: A word puzzle needs to know whether two words use the same letters. Write a function that returns true when the two lowercase strings are anagrams of each other, otherwise false.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Anagram Check, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A word puzzle needs to know whether two words use the same letters. Write a function that returns true when the two lowercase strings are anagrams of each other, otherwise false. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
explanation.junior: Treat this as a small pure JavaScript function: avoid mutating inputs unless the prompt explicitly asks for it, return the requested shape exactly, and let the tests drive the edge cases. The main practice area is strings and sorting. Pay attention to edge cases and keep the transformation predictable as the input grows.
